answer_4.quote: We randomly select a set of 200 samples from the Merged/Balanced split ... We conduct our evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk. For each image-caption pair we ask 5 workers the following three questions: (a) "Could this image belong to the given caption?" (Yes/No), (b) "How confident are you in your answer?" (1: Very, 2: Somewhat, 3: Not at all), (c) "Would it help to use a search engine to be more confident?" (Yes/No).
answer_4.guideline: Workers answer three questions per sample: plausibility (yes/no), confidence level (1‑3), and whether a search engine would help.
